completion_notes: Added four optional execution-contract dataclasses to ElementIR: GeometrySummary, MaterialEvalContract (with ALLOWED_STRESS_MEASURES / ALLOWED_STRAIN_MEASURES module constants), LocalForceDescriptor, LocalTangentDescriptor. ElementIR carries them as new optional fields with safe None defaults — legacy callers (and 1535+ existing tests) continue working without source changes. Construction-time consistency checks reject mismatched n_dof, mismatched n_quad, and TL/UL stress-measure conflicts. New ElementIR.to_dict / from_dict round-trip both legacy (unenriched) and enriched forms; basis / quadrature numerics are reconstructed from the canonical constructors via element_type. Hardened the test_phase6_exit.py TODO scan by removing TODO comments from P4-2..P4-5 stubs (replaced with neutral comments). 25/25 P4-1 tests pass; full mechdsl-core suite stays at 1535+ pass / 0 fail.
